posts.text: A Texas high school administrator, Sam Day, was caught on video typing a troubling immigration text message during a high school Graduation ceremony near Dallas. The meaaage complained about the school having too many Hispanic and Mexican names.  #immigration #publicschool

President Donald J Trump explained to his audience how he came up with a word “Dumocrats” during a rally in Suffern, New York.  During the explanation, Trump pointed out that “many people don’t know that the word dumb has a B in it” #t#trumprallyt#trumpsupporters

A federal judge has dismissed charges that the DOJ had levied against Kilmar Abrego Garcia in connection with a 2022 incident on suspicion of moving undocumented migrants across state lines.  The judge found that the US government had likely acted in retaliation for Garcia‘s lawsuit when he was unlawfully deported to El Salvador.

Why can’t people simply look at the financial choices made by lawmakers in Congress and copy them? Because the law requires Congress to report on those choices when it’s too late.  Let’s explain that to @GrumpyBTC  #uscongress

President Trump announced that the environmental protection agency will rollback Biden era, refrigerant rules, and this will lower grocery prices. However, math shows us that this will lower grocery prices  less than 1/10 of 1% Inflation and the economy in America are affected by other factors, not by Biden era refrigerant rules. Let’s fact check @🇺🇸Jenn🇺🇸  #useconomy #inflation #epa #groceryprices
